title: Fly back to Lima

weather.note: Back to mild & grey in Lima; perfect for a last easy evening in Miraflores or Barranco.

glance: Bus to Juliaca, flight to Lima, free final evening. A great chance for one more special meal — keep it in Barranco.

picks.name: Isolina
picks.note: José del Castillo's nostalgic Limeño tavern; huge sharing plates; on Latin America's 50 Best. Reserve.
picks.address: Isolina, Av. San Martín 101, Barranco, Lima

picks.name: Mayo
picks.note: Central's cocktail bar; a stylish nightcap.
